name: Huijin Shiwusuo
source:
Run a detective agency, investigate Anomalous cases, and uncover the truth behind your mentor's death.

After the death of operative Ash Gray, all she left Lin Mo was a scorched ring and a single message: Ash to ashes.

To uncover the true cause of Ash's death, Lin Mo leaves the secret organization "Vesper" and travels to her hometown, Collins City, to reopen the Ash Detective Agency she founded.

In this seemingly peaceful metropolis, unrest simmers beneath the surface. As Lin Mo takes on a series of cases, he gradually uncovers the truth buried deep within the city. Government elites and underground radical factions struggle for power, while tensions between the Anomalous and ordinary humans continue to escalate. Ash's death seems to be connected to it all.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4413550/Echoes_of_Ash/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经营一家侦探社，调查异常案件，并揭开导师死亡背后的真相。

特工阿什·格雷死后，留给林默的只有一枚烧焦的戒指和一条信息：灰归灰。

为了查明小智的真正死因，林默离开了秘密组织“维斯珀”，前往家乡柯林斯市，重新开设了她创办的小智侦探社。

在这座看似平静的大都市，表面之下却暗藏着不安。随着林默接手一系列案件，他逐渐揭开深埋在城市深处的真相。政府精英和地下激进派系争夺权力，而异常者和普通人类之间的紧张关系持续升级。阿什的死似乎与这一切有关。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4413550/Echoes_of_Ash/]Steam[/url]]
